content: बीभत्स {%a.%} [बध् स्वार्थे सन्] .²1 Disgusting, loathsome, nauseous, hideous, revolting; हन्त बीभत्समेवाग्रे वर्तते <ls>Māl. 5</ls> ‘Oh! it is indeed a loathsome sight’. .²2 Envious, malignant, mischievous. .²3 Savage, cruel, ferocious. .²4 Estranged in mind. .²5 Loathing, detesting; बीभत्सुरतिबीभत्सं कर्मेदमकरोत् कथम् <ls>Mb. 11. 24. 13</ls>. .²6 Sinful, wicked. .{@-त्सः@} .²1 Disgust, abhorrence, detestation. .²2 The disgusting sentiment, one of the 8 or 9 {%rasas%} in poetry; जुगुप्सास्थायिभावस्तु बीभत्सः कथ्यते रसः <ls>S. D. 236</ls>. ({%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} <ls>Māl. 5. 16.</ls>). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Arjuna. .{@-त्सा@} Loathing, abhorrence. .{@-त्सम्@} Anything loathsome.
